				<div id="bodyContent" class="vector-body" aria-labelledby="firstHeading" data-mw-ve-target-container>
					<div class="vector-body-before-content">
							<div class="mw-indicators">
		</div>

						<div id="siteSub" class="noprint">From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia</div>
					</div>
					<div id="contentSub"><div id="mw-content-subtitle"></div></div>
					
					
					<div id="mw-content-text" class="mw-body-content"><div class="mw-subjectpageheader">
</div><div class="mw-content-ltr mw-parser-output" lang="en" dir="ltr"><div class="shortdescription nomobile noexcerpt noprint searchaux" style="display:none">1967 canoe race</div>
<style data-mw-deduplicate="TemplateStyles:r1316064257">.mw-parser-output .infobox-subbox{padding:0;border:none;margin:-3px;width:auto;min-width:100%;font-size:100%;clear:none;float:none;background-color:transparent;color:inherit}.mw-parser-output .infobox-3cols-child{margin:-3px}.mw-parser-output .infobox .navbar{font-size:100%}@media screen{html.skin-theme-clientpref-night .mw-parser-output .infobox-full-data:not(.notheme)>div:not(.notheme)[style]{background:#1f1f23!important;color:#f8f9fa}}@media screen and (prefers-color-scheme:dark){html.skin-theme-clientpref-os .mw-parser-output .infobox-full-data:not(.notheme)>div:not(.notheme)[style]{background:#1f1f23!important;color:#f8f9fa}}@media(min-width:640px){body.skin--responsive .mw-parser-output .infobox-table{display:table!important}body.skin--responsive .mw-parser-output .infobox-table>caption{display:table-caption!important}body.skin--responsive .mw-parser-output .infobox-table>tbody{display:table-row-group}body.skin--responsive .mw-parser-output .infobox-table th,body.skin--responsive .mw-parser-output .infobox-table td{padding-left:inherit;padding-right:inherit}}</style><table class="infobox"><caption class="infobox-title">Centennial Voyageur Canoe Pageant</caption><tbody><tr><td colspan="2" class="infobox-image"><span class="mw-default-size" typeof="mw:File/Frameless"><a href="/wiki/File:Centennial_Voyageurs_Race_Start.png" class="mw-file-description"><img src="//upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/en/thumb/7/7b/Centennial_Voyageurs_Race_Start.png/250px-Centennial_Voyageurs_Race_Start.png" decoding="async" width="250" height="144" class="mw-file-element" srcset="//upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/en/thumb/7/7b/Centennial_Voyageurs_Race_Start.png/416px-Centennial_Voyageurs_Race_Start.png 1.5x, //upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/en/7/7b/Centennial_Voyageurs_Race_Start.png 2x" data-file-width="416" data-file-height="239" /></a></span><div class="infobox-caption">Start of race at <a href="/wiki/Rocky_Mountain_House" title="Rocky Mountain House">Rocky Mountain House</a>. Photograph by Frank Grant.</div></td></tr><tr><th colspan="2" class="infobox-header">Event information</th></tr><tr><th scope="row" class="infobox-label">Type</th><td class="infobox-data">canoe race</td></tr><tr><th scope="row" class="infobox-label">Race area</th><td class="infobox-data">Rocky Mountains to Montreal</td></tr><tr><th scope="row" class="infobox-label">Dates</th><td class="infobox-data">May 24, 1967 - September 4, 1967</td></tr><tr><th scope="row" class="infobox-label">Nations</th><td class="infobox-data">Canada</td></tr><tr><th scope="row" class="infobox-label">Distance</th><td class="infobox-data">5,283 kilometers</td></tr></tbody></table>
<p>The <b>Centennial Voyageur Canoe Pageant</b> was a canoe race started on <a href="/wiki/Victoria_Day" title="Victoria Day">May 24</a>, <a href="/wiki/Canadian_Centennial" title="Canadian Centennial">1967</a> in the Rocky Mountains by ten teams representing eight provinces and the <a href="/wiki/Yukon_Territory" class="mw-redirect" title="Yukon Territory">Yukon Territory</a> and <a href="/wiki/Northwest_Territories" title="Northwest Territories">Northwest Territories</a>. Prince Edward Island and Newfoundland, the two remaining provinces were not entered. 3,283 miles (5,283&#160;km) were paddled and <a href="/wiki/Portage" title="Portage">portaged</a> in 104 days by 100 men using six man shifts per team. They arrived in Montreal on September 4. Other privately sponsored canoes from across the country made similar trips.<sup id="cite&#95;ref-1" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-1"><span class="cite-bracket">&#91;</span>1<span class="cite-bracket">&#93;</span></a></sup><sup id="cite&#95;ref-2" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-2"><span class="cite-bracket">&#91;</span>2<span class="cite-bracket">&#93;</span></a></sup>
As of March 2012, it still holds the <a href="/wiki/Guinness_World_Records" title="Guinness World Records">Guinness</a> record for longest canoeing race in history.<sup id="cite&#95;ref-3" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-3"><span class="cite-bracket">&#91;</span>3<span class="cite-bracket">&#93;</span></a></sup>
</p>
<meta property="mw:PageProp/toc" />
<div class="mw-heading mw-heading2"><h2 id="Beginnings">Beginnings</h2><span class="mw-editsection"><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</span><a href="/w/index.php?title=Centennial_Voyageur_Canoe_Pageant&amp;action=edit&amp;section=1" title="Edit section: Beginnings"><span>edit</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</span></span></div>
<p>The Centennial Commission was started in 1963, with the mandate of organizing numerous projects 
to promote the first <a href="/wiki/Canadian_Centennial" title="Canadian Centennial">Canadian Centennial</a>.<sup id="cite&#95;ref-4" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-4"><span class="cite-bracket">&#91;</span>4<span class="cite-bracket">&#93;</span></a></sup> Regional governments advertised for participants. Every man that officially completed the trip would receive $1000 (CDN$9,072 in 2025 dollars<sup id="cite&#95;ref-inflation-CA&#95;5-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-inflation-CA-5"><span class="cite-bracket">&#91;</span>5<span class="cite-bracket">&#93;</span></a></sup>). The winning team an additional $1,500 per man and $500 for 2nd/3rd.  There were other contests along the route as well.<sup id="cite&#95;ref-6" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-6"><span class="cite-bracket">&#91;</span>6<span class="cite-bracket">&#93;</span></a></sup>
</p>
<div class="mw-heading mw-heading2"><h2 id="The_canoes">The canoes</h2><span class="mw-editsection"><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</span><a href="/w/index.php?title=Centennial_Voyageur_Canoe_Pageant&amp;action=edit&amp;section=2" title="Edit section: The canoes"><span>edit</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</span></span></div>
<p>Twelve canoes were built for promotion and trials in 1966 by the <a href="/wiki/Chestnut_Canoe_Company" title="Chestnut Canoe Company">Chestnut Canoe Company</a>. The 10 canoes used the following year in the race were built by Moise Cadorette.<sup id="cite&#95;ref-7" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-7"><span class="cite-bracket">&#91;</span>7<span class="cite-bracket">&#93;</span></a></sup>
</p>
<div class="mw-heading mw-heading2"><h2 id="The_route">The route</h2><span class="mw-editsection"><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</span><a href="/w/index.php?title=Centennial_Voyageur_Canoe_Pageant&amp;action=edit&amp;section=3" title="Edit section: The route"><span>edit</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</span></span></div>
<figure typeof="mw:File/Thumb"><a href="/wiki/File:Canada_relief_map_public_domain.png" class="mw-file-description"><img src="//upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/3/36/Canada_relief_map_public_domain.png/500px-Canada_relief_map_public_domain.png" decoding="async" width="467" height="488" class="mw-file-element" srcset="//upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/3/36/Canada_relief_map_public_domain.png/960px-Canada_relief_map_public_domain.png 1.5x" data-file-width="1160" data-file-height="1212" /></a><figcaption>Relief map courtesy of Courtesy of the <a href="/wiki/University_of_Texas" class="mw-redirect" title="University of Texas">University of Texas Libraries</a>, <a href="/wiki/Perry%E2%80%93Casta%C3%B1eda_Library_Map_Collection" title="Perry–Castañeda Library Map Collection">Perry–Castañeda Library Map Collection</a> and the <a href="/wiki/Central_Intelligence_Agency" title="Central Intelligence Agency">Central Intelligence Agency</a></figcaption></figure>
<figure typeof="mw:File/Thumb"><a href="/wiki/File:NorthAmerica-WaterDivides.png" class="mw-file-description"><img src="//upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/1/15/NorthAmerica-WaterDivides.png/250px-NorthAmerica-WaterDivides.png" decoding="async" width="200" height="200" class="mw-file-element" srcset="//upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/1/15/NorthAmerica-WaterDivides.png/330px-NorthAmerica-WaterDivides.png 1.5x, //upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/1/15/NorthAmerica-WaterDivides.png/500px-NorthAmerica-WaterDivides.png 2x" data-file-width="900" data-file-height="900" /></a><figcaption><a href="/wiki/Portage" title="Portage">Portages</a> needed to be done over the <a href="/wiki/Continental_divide" title="Continental divide">divides</a></figcaption></figure>
<p>Expo 67 Official Guide Book Schedule:
</p>
